title: Ek tick matlab block? WhatsApp ke tick ka asli matlab
topic: WhatsApp ticks: store-and-forward server, delivery and read receipts, 30-day undelivered queue
world: Message = chitthi; server = beech ka dakghar

experiment.change: New house style 'stage' (bright room, both characters always on screen, hook fully built at frame 0) + a quiz ending
experiment.why: Eps 1-4 opened on an empty dark frame and lost people in ~6 s; every outlier we studied fills the frame from frame 0 and keeps its characters on screen

hooks: Wrong belief: Intern panics 'Usne block kar diya, ek hi tick hai!' over a board '1 tick = Block?'
Lived moment: 'Raat 11 baje, crush ko Hi bheja. 2 ghante. Ek tick.'
Absurd question: 'Tumhara message 2 ghante kahan chhupa tha?'

leadMagnet.promise: Message ka poora safar, ek page mein

caption:
Comment TICK for message ka poora safar, ek page mein. DM mein bhejta hoon.

Ek tick dekh ke socha usne block kar diya? Ruko. Ek tick ka matlab sirf itna hai: message server tak gaya, uske phone tak nahi.

Us dost ko bhejo jo ek tick dekh ke panic karta hai.

1 grey tick: message bhej diya gaya.
2 grey tick: uske phone tak pahuncha.
2 blue tick: usne padh liya.
Phone off ho, toh WhatsApp message apne server pe rok ke rakhta hai, 30 din tak, phir delete.

Quiz: group mein blue tick kab aata hai? A: ek ne padha, B: sabne padha. Comment karo, answer pinned comment mein.

Save karo, kaam aayega.

scenes.vo: भैया, उसने मुझे block कर दिया. दो घंटे से एक ही tick है!
scenes.title: 1 tick = Block?

scenes.vo: रुक. एक tick से block पक्का नहीं होता.
scenes.line: Ruk. Ek tick se block pakka nahi hota.

scenes.vo: तेरा message सीधा उसके phone पे नहीं जाता. पहले server पे.
एक tick मतलब: message भेज दिया गया. Phone तक नहीं पहुँचा.
scenes.title: 1 tick = Bheja

scenes.vo: तो उसके phone तक क्यों नहीं गया?
scenes.line: Toh uske phone tak kyun nahi gaya?

scenes.vo: Phone बंद, net नहीं, या block. सिर्फ tick से पक्का नहीं कह सकते.
scenes.title: 1 tick ke reason

scenes.vo: तब तक server message रोक के रखता है. Phone online होते ही, deliver.
WhatsApp की policy कहती है: undelivered message, तीस दिन तक. फिर delete.
scenes.label: din tak server pe (undelivered)

scenes.vo: Phone तक पहुँचते ही वापस signal आता है: मिल गया. दूसरा tick.
scenes.title: 2 tick = Phone tak

scenes.vo: और blue tick कब होता है, भैया?
scenes.line: Aur blue tick kab hota hai, bhaiya?

scenes.vo: जब वो chat खोलता है, तब read receipt वापस आती है. Blue tick.
scenes.title: Blue = Chat khola

scenes.vo: ये cheat sheet save कर लो. अगली बार panic मत करना.
scenes.title: Tick ka matlab
